hypotheses.storyTitle: Reviewing Holiday Goal & Statement Credit Options
hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: Daniel views his 7,300 coin balance and evaluates current statement credit progress toward his Holiday Spending Money goal.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Customer visits the rewards overview on mobile with the intent to check balances and evaluate statement credit options.
hypotheses.storyTension: Determining how current point totals translate into bill reduction and progress toward the 1,200 target.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Clear visibility of cash-equivalent point value, 53% goal progress, and straightforward statement credit redemption pathways.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Immediate clarity on cash-equivalent value and progress toward payment-linked savings goals.

hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: Daniel examines his payment-linked reward allocation and confirms automatic statement credit settings.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Customer checks cashback earned alongside balance and reviews automatic payment reward allocations.

hypotheses.customerResolution: Confirmation that automatic payment rewards are active and aligned with bill reduction preferences.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Immediate clarity on cash-equivalent value and progress toward payment-linked savings goals.
